room_rent.note: Room rent capped at 1% of Sum Insured per day

icu.note: ICU/ICCU expenses capped at 2% of Sum Insured per day

copayment.note: Mandatory 20% co-payment on every admissible claim; can be waived by paying additional optional premium

sub_limits.display: Cataract ₹40,000/eye; Modern treatments 50% of SI; AYUSH 50% of SI
sub_limits.note: Cataract sub-limited to ₹40,000 per eye per year; Modern treatments capped at 50% of SI; AYUSH capped at 50% of SI

ped_waiting.note: 24 months for pre-existing disability; 36 months for all other pre-existing conditions except HIV/AIDS

specific_disease_waiting.note: 19 listed conditions including cataract, hernia, ENT disorders, varicose veins, etc.

maternity.note: Maternity explicitly excluded under Excl18; ectopic pregnancy is covered

cumulative_bonus.note: Cumulative bonus defined in definitions but no specific rate or cap mentioned in wording

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy wording

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalization expenses explicitly excluded under Section 4.2.11

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment covered up to 50% of Sum Insured per policy year

organ_donor.note: Hospitalization for donation of body organs by insured explicitly excluded

ambulance.note: Road ambulance reimbursement capped at ₹2,000 per hospitalisation

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, stereotactic, deep brain stimulation, etc.) covered up to 50% of SI

consumables.note: Extensive list of non-payable consumables in Annexure 1

global_cover.note: Treatment outside India explicitly excluded; territorial limit is India only

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months, no claim contestable except on grounds of established fraud

grace_period.note: Coverage not available during grace period

free_look.note: Applicable only at inception, not on renewals or porting

notable_exclusions: Domiciliary treatment, organ donor hospitalisation, treatment outside India, ART/HIV treatment costs, STDs, OPD treatment, stem cell storage, alternative medicine
